Who owns U.S. patents: American companies, foreign companies, individuals or governments?

SELECT CASE cast(assignee_type AS varchar) WHEN '2' THEN 'U.S. company' WHEN '3' THEN 'foreign company' WHEN '4' THEN 'U.S. individual' WHEN '5' THEN 'foreign individual' WHEN '6' THEN 'U.S. federal government' WHEN '7' THEN 'foreign government' WHEN '8' THEN 'U.S. county government' WHEN '9' THEN 'U.S. state government' ELSE 'other' END AS owner_type, count(*) AS assignments, round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_assignee_disambiguated GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What types of patent application are filed most, regular, provisional, reissue or reexamination?
SELECT application_type, count(*) AS applications FROM govblock_patents.patex_application_data_25 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the total vote in U.S. House general elections change from 2014 to 2018?
SELECT year, sum(try_cast(candidatevotes AS double)) AS votes FROM govblock_elections.medsl_house_returns WHERE stage = 'GEN' AND year IN ('2014', '2018') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which categories of drinking water violation are most common?

SELECT CASE violation_category_code WHEN 'MCL' THEN 'Maximum contaminant level' WHEN 'MR' THEN 'Monitoring and reporting' WHEN 'MON' THEN 'Monitoring' WHEN 'RPT' THEN 'Reporting' WHEN 'TT' THEN 'Treatment technique' WHEN 'MRDL' THEN 'Maximum residual disinfectant level' ELSE violation_category_code END AS category, count(DISTINCT violation_id) AS violations FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_violations_enforcement GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many particle entries does the Particle Data Group list?
SELECT count(DISTINCT name) AS particles FROM govblock_physics.pdg_pdgparticle
Which public schools had the largest enrolments in 2024-25?

SELECT sch_name, st, try_cast(student_count AS double) AS students FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_052 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' AND total_indicator = 'Education Unit Total' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many utility rate schedules come with net metering rules?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.utility_rate_database WHERE dgrules = 'Net Metering'
Which databases contribute the most compound records to UniChem?

SELECT s.name_long, count(*) AS records FROM govblock_chemistry.unichem_reference AS r JOIN govblock_chemistry.unichem_source AS s ON cast(s.src_id AS varchar) = cast(r.src_id AS varchar) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many economically significant rules did OIRA finish reviewing in 2023?
SELECT count(*) AS reviews FROM govblock_executive.oira_eo_reviews_completed WHERE economically_significant = 'Yes' AND cast(date_completed AS varchar) LIKE '2023%'
Which utilities have the most rate schedules in the Utility Rate Database?
SELECT utility, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.utility_rate_database WHERE utility IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the presidential vote cast in Florida change from 1976 to 2020?
SELECT year, max(try_cast(totalvotes AS double)) AS votes FROM govblock_elections.medsl_president_returns WHERE state_po = 'FL' AND year IN ('1976', '2020') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Apart from the United States, which countries do federally bought goods and services come from most?

SELECT country_of_product_or_service_origin, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE cast(action_date_fiscal_year AS varchar) = '2024' AND country_of_product_or_service_origin_code <> 'USA' AND country_of_product_or_service_origin IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many GAO reports have cybersecurity in the title?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_oversight.oversight_reports WHERE source = 'GAO' AND lower(title) LIKE '%cybersecurity%'
Which neighbouring grids did New York trade the most power with in 2023?

SELECT directly_interconnected_balancing_authority, sum(abs(try_cast(interchange_mw AS double))) AS mwh_traded FROM govblock_solar.eia930_interchange WHERE balancing_authority = 'NYIS' AND data_date LIKE '%/2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which Labor Department rules about overtime have appeared on the regulatory agenda?
SELECT DISTINCT rin, rule_title FROM govblock_executive.oira_unified_agenda WHERE acronym LIKE '%DOL%' AND lower(rule_title) LIKE '%overtime%' LIMIT 10
Which states record the most hazardous waste violations?
SELECT activity_location, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_rcra_violations WHERE activity_location IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many citation links between opinions does the archive map?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.citation_map
Which states have the most hospices enrolled in Medicare?
SELECT state, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.cms_hospice_enrollments WHERE state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many counties does the block crosswalk cover in Georgia?
SELECT count(DISTINCT cty) AS n FROM govblock_labor.lodes_xwalk WHERE stusps = 'GA'
Which New York subsidized housing projects have the most units?
SELECT name, try_cast(total_units AS double) AS units FROM govblock_housing.hud_psh_project WHERE states LIKE 'NY%' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is aspirin's CAS registry number?
SELECT c1 AS cas_number FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_identifiers WHERE c0 = '2244' AND c2 = 'CAS'
Organisations in which states receive the most sub-award dollars?

SELECT sub_legal_entity_state_name, sum(try_cast(subaward_amount AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_subaward_search WHERE sub_legal_entity_state_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of closed Texas rate filings were withdrawn by the insurer?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN closed_type = 'Withdrawn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_insurance_filings.tx_property_casualty_rate_filings WHERE status = 'Closed'
Which countries do inventors on U.S. patent applications come from most often?
SELECT inventor_country_code, count(*) AS inventors FROM govblock_patents.patex_inventors_25 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the average energy of the aspirin frames in revised MD17?
SELECT avg(energy_kcal_mol) AS average FROM govblock_chemistry.rmd17_frames WHERE molecule = 'aspirin'
Which New York ZIP codes reported the most total income on tax returns for 2021?
Income by ZIP Code and County

SELECT zipcode, sum(try_cast(a00100 AS double)) AS agi_thousands FROM govblock_tax.soi_zip_zpallagi WHERE state = 'NY' AND source_file LIKE '%/21zpallagi%' AND zipcode NOT IN ('00000', '99999') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many U.S. reactors are pressurised water and how many boiling water designs?
SELECT substr(reactor_and_containment_type, 1, 3) AS design, count(*) AS reactors FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_dataset_reactors_operating_query_1 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which facilities injected the most toxic chemicals underground in 2022?

SELECT _4_facility_name AS facility, _8_st AS state, round(sum(try_cast(_54_54_underground AS double))) AS pounds FROM govblock_environment.tri_basic WHERE cast(_1_year AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many compounds were confirmed active against HIV in the screening set?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.moleculenet_hiv WHERE activity = 'CA'
Which states spent the most on energy in 2023?

SELECT substr(series_id, 12, 2) AS state, try_cast(value AS double) AS million_dollars FROM govblock_energy.eia_seds_data WHERE series_id LIKE 'SEDS.TETCV.%.A' AND length(series_id) = 15 AND substr(series_id, 12, 2) NOT IN ('US', 'X3', 'X5') AND period = '2023' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Were there more road deaths in 2019, before the pandemic, or in 2021?
SELECT year, sum(try_cast(fatals AS integer)) AS deaths FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE cast(year AS varchar) IN ('2019', '2021') GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
What did the Department of Defense buy most in Hawaii in fiscal year 2024?

SELECT product_or_service_code_description, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE awarding_agency_name = 'DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE' AND primary_place_of_performance_state_code = 'HI' AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much natural gas was in Lower 48 underground storage in the week ending November 1, 2024?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS billion_cubic_feet FROM govblock_energy.eia_ng_data WHERE series_id = 'NG.NW2_EPG0_SWO_R48_BCF.W' AND period = '20241101'
Which New York counties have the highest poverty rates?

SELECT g.name, round(100 * (max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B17001_E002' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END)) / max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B17001_E001' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END), 1) AS pct_poverty FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0500000US36%' AND a.table_id = 'b17001' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many materials in the Materials Project are metals?
SELECT count(*) AS materials FROM govblock_materials.mp_summary WHERE cast(is_metal AS varchar) = 'true'
What are unwanted calls most often about, by Do Not Call complaints?
SELECT subject, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_consumer.ftc_dnc_complaints WHERE subject IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much carbon dioxide did power plants in New York emit in 2021?
SELECT sum(co2_mass_short_tons) AS co2_short_tons FROM govblock_environment.campd_emissions_hourly WHERE state = 'NY' AND year(date) = 2021
Which counties in Florida have the oldest median age?

SELECT g.name, try_cast(a.value AS double) AS median_age FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 AS a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_5yr AS g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0500000US12%' AND a.variable = 'B01002_E001' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the GDP of Harris County, Texas, in 2023?
SELECT try_cast(_2023 AS double) AS gdp_thousands FROM govblock_economy.bea_cagdp2 WHERE geofips = '48201' AND linecode = '1'
Which diagnosis groups cost New York hospitals the most in 2016?

SELECT apr_drg_description, sum(try_cast(total_costs AS double)) AS costs FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges WHERE discharge_year = '2016' AND apr_drg_description IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many companies based outside the United States file financial statements with the SEC?
SELECT count(DISTINCT cik) AS companies FROM govblock_sec.sec_fsds_sub WHERE countryba <> 'US'
Which states have the largest number of public schools?
SELECT statename, count(*) AS schools FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_029 WHERE school_year = '2023-2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many Zenodo physics and chemistry records were published each year from 2015 to 2024?
SELECT publication_year, count(*) AS records FROM govblock_scholarly.zenodo_records WHERE try_cast(publication_year AS integer) BETWEEN 2015 AND 2024 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which states bought the most electricity at retail in 2020?

SELECT column06 AS state, round(sum(try_cast(sales_4 AS double))) AS mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia861_sales_ult_cust_sheet_states WHERE column00 = '2020' AND column03 IN ('A', 'B') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many power plants on the national map are listed as retired?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.hifld_power_plants WHERE status = 'RE'
Which institutions have received the most National Science Foundation award dollars?
SELECT name, sum(try_cast(awardamount AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_grants.nsf_awards GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
In what share of office actions does the examiner find claims obvious?
SELECT round(100.0 * count_if(rejection_103 = '1') / count(*), 1) AS pct_obviousness FROM govblock_patents.oa_research_office_actions
Which hospitals reported the most beds in their fiscal 2023 cost reports?

SELECT a.itm_alphnmrc_itm_txt AS hospital, max(try_cast(n.itm_val_num AS double)) AS beds FROM govblock_health.hcris_hosp10_nmrc AS n JOIN govblock_health.hcris_hosp10_alpha AS a ON a.rpt_rec_num = n.rpt_rec_num AND a.wksht_cd = 'S200001' AND a.line_num = '00300' AND a.clmn_num = '00100' WHERE n.wksht_cd = 'S300001' AND n.line_num = '01400' AND n.clmn_num = '00200' AND cast(n.hcris_fy AS varchar) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
What was per capita personal income in Manhattan in 2024?
SELECT try_cast(_2024 AS double) AS per_capita_income FROM govblock_economy.bea_cainc1 WHERE geofips = '36061' AND linecode = '3'
Which companies spent the most on research and development in fiscal 2021?

SELECT s.name, max(n.value) AS research_and_development FROM govblock_sec.sec_fsds_num n JOIN govblock_sec.sec_fsds_sub s ON s.adsh = n.adsh WHERE n.tag = 'ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense' AND cast(n.qtrs AS varchar) = '4' AND s.form = '10-K' AND cast(s.fy AS varchar) = '2021' AND n.uom = 'USD' AND (n.segments IS NULL OR n.segments = '') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of Grants.gov opportunities are plain grants rather than cooperative agreements?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN fundinginstrumenttype = 'G' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_awards.grantsgov_opportunity_synopsis
Which companies have issued the most medical device recalls?
SELECT recalling_firm, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.fda_device_recall WHERE recalling_firm IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
When was the first patent application in the file published?
Which federal assistance programs paid out the most in fiscal year 2023?

SELECT cfda_title, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_assistance WHERE cast(action_date_fiscal_year AS varchar) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which medical subject heading is attached to PubChem compound 2244?
SELECT c1 AS mesh_heading FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_mesh WHERE c0 = '2244' LIMIT 10
Which companies received the most federal contract money for work in Alaska in fiscal year 2024?

SELECT recipient_name, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE primary_place_of_performance_state_code = 'AK' AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many offshore wells on the outer continental shelf are permanently abandoned?
Hifld Ocs Oil And Natural Gas Wells
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.hifld_ocs_oil_and_natural_gas_wells WHERE replace(status, '"', '') = 'PA'
Which statutes are cited most often as the cause of action in federal dockets?
SELECT cause, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.dockets WHERE cause IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many SAM.gov registrants are veteran-owned?
SELECT count(DISTINCT unique_entity_id) AS n FROM govblock_awards.sam_entity_business_types WHERE business_type_code = 'A5'
Which EPA enforcement cases carried the largest assessed penalties?
SELECT case_name, try_cast(total_penalty_assessed_amt AS double) AS penalty FROM govblock_environment.echo_case_enforcements ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of Navy contract dollars in Virginia went to small businesses in fiscal year 2024?

SELECT contracting_officers_determination_of_business_size, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE awarding_sub_agency_name = 'DEPT OF THE NAVY' AND primary_place_of_performance_state_code = 'VA' AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2024' GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which federal departments funded the research behind the most published patent applications?
SELECT level_one AS department, count(DISTINCT pgpub_id) AS applications FROM govblock_patents.pv_pg_gov_interest_org GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which diseases are mentioned in the most chemistry patents?

SELECT e.corrected_text AS disease, count(DISTINCT l.patent_id) AS patents FROM govblock_chemistry.surechembl_biomedical_locations AS l JOIN govblock_chemistry.surechembl_biomedical_entities AS e ON cast(e.id AS varchar) = cast(l.entity_id AS varchar) JOIN govblock_chemistry.surechembl_biomedical_types AS t ON cast(t.id AS varchar) = cast(e.type_id AS varchar) WHERE t.type_name = 'Disease' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which companies have received the most recorded patent assignments?
SELECT ee_name, count(*) AS assignments FROM govblock_patents.assign_assignee GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which research concepts are tagged on the most works?
SELECT display_name, try_cast(works_count AS double) AS works FROM govblock_scholarly.openalex_concepts ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What are the tallest wind turbines in California?
SELECT p_name, t_model, try_cast(t_ttlh AS double) AS total_height_m FROM govblock_energy.wind_uswtdb_uswtdb_v WHERE t_state = 'CA' ORDER BY 3 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
Which counties cast the most presidential votes in 2024?

SELECT concat(county_name, ', ', state_po) AS county, max(try_cast(totalvotes AS double)) AS votes FROM govblock_elections.medsl_county_president_returns WHERE year = '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which ATC anatomical groups contain the most drugs?
SELECT level1_description, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_atc_classification WHERE level1_description IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which states have the most sections of law in the library?
SELECT state, count(*) AS sections FROM govblock_law.law_combined GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which trial judges' rulings are appealed most often?
SELECT ordering_judge_str, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.originating_court_information WHERE ordering_judge_str IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which New York counties had the highest average unemployment rate in 2024?

SELECT a.area_text AS county, try_cast(d.value AS double) AS rate FROM govblock_labor.bls_la_data d JOIN govblock_labor.bls_la_series s ON s.series_id = d.series_id JOIN govblock_labor.bls_la_area a ON a.area_code = s.area_code WHERE s.area_type_code = 'F' AND s.measure_code = '03' AND a.area_text LIKE '%, NY' AND cast(d.year AS varchar) = '2024' AND d.period = 'M13' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which drugs cost Medicare Part D the most in New York?
Medicare Part D Prescribers By Provider And Drug

SELECT gnrc_name, sum(try_cast(tot_drug_cst AS double)) AS cost FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_provider_and_drug WHERE prscrbr_state_abrvtn = 'NY' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which stable materials in the Materials Project have the widest band gaps?
SELECT formula_pretty, try_cast(band_gap AS double) AS band_gap_ev FROM govblock_materials.mp_summary WHERE try_cast(energy_above_hull AS double) = 0 ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
Which 13F filings list the greatest number of separate holdings?

SELECT c.filingmanager_name, max(try_cast(s.tableentrytotal AS double)) AS holdings FROM govblock_sec.sec_13f_summarypage s JOIN govblock_sec.sec_13f_coverpage c ON c.accession_number = s.accession_number GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Where do New York hospital patients go after they are discharged?
SELECT patient_disposition, count(*) AS discharges FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What kinds of informal enforcement do regulators use most against water polluters?
SELECT enf_type_desc, count(*) AS actions FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_informal_enforcement_actions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which active banks hold the most assets?
SELECT name, try_cast(asset AS double) AS assets_thousands FROM govblock_finance.fdic_institutions WHERE active = '1' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
Which states had the lowest per capita income in 1950?
SELECT geoname, try_cast(y1950 AS double) AS per_capita_income FROM govblock_economy.bea_sainc1 WHERE linecode = '3' AND geofips BETWEEN '01000' AND '56000' ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 10
Which Grants.gov opportunities offered the largest award ceilings?
SELECT opportunitytitle, max(try_cast(awardceiling AS double)) AS award_ceiling FROM govblock_awards.grantsgov_opportunity_synopsis GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
Which agencies bought the most from small businesses in New York last fiscal year?

SELECT awarding_agency_name, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE primary_place_of_performance_state_code = 'NY' AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2025' AND contracting_officers_determination_of_business_size = 'SMALL BUSINESS' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which states use the most energy per person?

SELECT substr(series_id, 12, 2) AS state, try_cast(value AS double) AS million_btu_per_person FROM govblock_energy.eia_seds_data WHERE series_id LIKE 'SEDS.TETPB.%.A' AND length(series_id) = 15 AND substr(series_id, 12, 2) NOT IN ('US', 'X3', 'X5') AND period = '2023' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
In which countries are patent assignees based most often?
SELECT ee_country, count(*) AS assignments FROM govblock_patents.assign_assignee WHERE ee_country <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which companies earned the highest net income in their 2021 annual reports?

SELECT s.name, max(n.value) AS net_income FROM govblock_sec.sec_fsds_num n JOIN govblock_sec.sec_fsds_sub s ON s.adsh = n.adsh WHERE n.tag = 'NetIncomeLoss' AND cast(n.qtrs AS varchar) = '4' AND s.form = '10-K' AND cast(s.fy AS varchar) = '2021' AND n.uom = 'USD' AND (n.segments IS NULL OR n.segments = '') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What do federal campaigns spend money on most, by category?
SELECT category_desc, sum(try_cast(transaction_amt AS double)) AS spent FROM govblock_fec.operating_expenditures GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What products are sold under wholesale electricity contracts?
SELECT product_name, count(*) AS contract_lines FROM govblock_energy.ferceqr_contracts WHERE year_quarter LIKE '2024%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which hospital outpatient services did Medicare patients receive most in 2023?
Medicare Outpatient Hospitals By Geography And Service

SELECT hcpcs_desc AS service, sum(try_cast(capc_srvcs AS double)) AS services FROM govblock_health.medicare_outpatient_hospitals_by_geography_and_service WHERE rndrng_prvdr_geo_lvl = 'National' AND source_file LIKE '%DY23%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
